global_caption: The video contains 11 shots. The overall color palette transitions uniformly from cool gray-blue to orange-red twilight. The first half uses natural mountain lighting, while the second half features seaside sunset backlighting and nighttime ambient light. The The emotional arc consistently revolves around two main tones: building tension and passionate release.
shot1: Shot 1 fades in from black, wide overhead composition includes snowy mountain, winding coastal highway, and stopped equipment van in one depth plane. Foreground shows rough road shoulder and sparse grass and stones; midground shows van parked at curve; Cool natural lighting makes pixelated edges appear crisp. Band begins unloading cases and stands from van doors—actions still in preparation phase. Camera slowly pushes down and forward, drawing viewers into the tour journey.

Tree trunks form vertical leading lines; drum kit centered; keyboard stand and speakers flanking sides. Shallow depth of field slightly blurs background mist. A young drummer crouches to secure hi-hat stand; another musician pulls cable toward generator. Low-saturation cold green forest light maintains consistent tone. English humming not yet fully engaged—only environment Camera pans across gear, ending on the moment of light drumhead vibration.

Cables, instrument straps, and hair stream backward, indicating direction. Color shifts from cool green to gray-blue sea wind and warming horizon. Drums and fan roar jointly drive forward momentum. English Camera tracks sideways with slight forward shift, fully extending sense of characters charging into open space.

Drummer arms open wide for heavy hit; electric guitar strumming amplitude increases noticeably. Backlight creates glowing pixel outline on subjects and instruments.
shot9: background sea reflection compressed into low-saturation flickering blocks. Wind lifts fabric and hair strands; Performance continues uninterrupted.
